data.title: Allis forceps
data.summary: Forceps & clamps · Ring-handled locking forceps with interdigitating teeth for a secure grip on tissue to be removed.
data.body:
![Allis forceps](instruments/allis-forceps.jpg)

_Also called: Allis tissue forceps_

Ring-handled locking forceps with interdigitating teeth for a secure grip on tissue to be removed.

## Parts
- Two straight blades, separated except at the tip
- Interdigitating teeth at the tip
- Ratchet lock near the handle (3 catches)
- Blades riveted together - the joint acts as fulcrum

## Uses / indications
- Corn enucleation
- Cyst excision (holding the cyst/tissue being removed)

## How to hold
Thumb and ring finger in the rings, index finger along the shanks for control; ratchet engaged/released by pressing the rings together and apart.

## Sterilisation & care
Autoclave, hot air oven, 2% glutaraldehyde or boiling

## Viva points & tips
- Traumatic - hold only tissue that will be removed (PPT1)
